Imprisoned at the International Space Station, a group of terrorists manages to escape confinement and take control of the ship. However, their mission to target the Soviets threatens world peace.

John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.
In a post-apocalyptic world, Regan and her family learn that the alien predators can be defeated using high-frequency audio. Soon, armed with this knowledge, they set out to look for other survivors.
Optimus Prime seeks his creator in space. Meanwhile, humans and Autobots join forces to save Earth from an ancient threat.
Dragon Warrior Po takes it upon himself to foil the plans of murderous peacock Shen who intends to conquer China and destroy kung fu. For this, Po has to unveil the mystery of his own past.
A few human survivors must team up with a group of dissenting Orcs to stop an Orc horde from invading their planet through a magic portal.
Following IMF's assimilation into the CIA, Ethan Hunt and his team face a new challenge from the Syndicate, an international rogue group determined to destroy their organisation.
Rick and his group accidentally awaken a mummy during an archaeological excavation.

The host invites prominent personalities and engages them in candid conversations about their personal and professional lives.
New power dynamics emerge amongst the survivors of the second ice age when they board a train travelling across the globe.

Loretta Sage, a novelist of ancient tombs and daring quests, faces real-life peril when abducted by an eccentric billionaire seeking a mythical lost city. Meanwhile, Alan, her attractive book cover model, launches a clumsy rescue attempt. Together, they navigate jungle dangers and interpersonal conflicts to unearth the fabled treasure before it vanishes forever.
Shrek is tired of his domesticated life and makes a deal with Rumpelstiltskin to live one day as a free ogre. But, this puts him in a dark alternate timeline where he never met his wife or friends.
Peter Parker's life changes when he is bitten by a genetically altered spider and gains superpowers. He uses his powers to help people and finds himself facing the Green Goblin, an evil maniac.
After Set, the Egyptian God of darkness, kills his brother and seizes the throne, he enslaves the kingdom. However, a flawed mortal, Bek, and the God of the sky Horus rise to challenge him.

A supervillain plans to steal the moon, but his carefully crafted schemes are complicated when three orphaned girls enter his life. He soon finds himself challenged by a new rival in the villainous world.
When an advanced cyber weapon is on the verge of falling into the wrong hands, Ethan Hunt and his team must embark on a challenging mission to save the world from destruction.
Princess Diana of an all-female Amazonian race rescues US pilot Steve. Upon learning of a war, she ventures into the world of men to stop Ares, the god of war, from destroying mankind.
John, son of Sarah Connor, sends a reprogrammed Terminator to protect his younger self, who also holds the key to humanity's survival, from the T-1000, an advanced robot created by Skynet.
